response.rationale: The item is defective (arrived broken in three pieces) and is not final sale, so RET-020 applies. As the highest-priority applicable rule (priority 90), it overrides the out-of-window ineligibility of RET-008 (37 days since delivery). RET-012 does not apply since final_sale is false, and RET-050/RET-051 do not apply.
